title: AngyHelper
description: This mod integrates a small set of features for the server Angybox.minehut.gg
body:
This mod adds a few features that help with the minecraft server `Angybox.minehut.gg`

# Features
### Timer Hud
Initially when you join the server, the timers will be disabled.

When the server sends the following message `[MRL] RESOURCE has been reset automatically!`, the Resource's timer will be enabled for the related resource.

Other people cannot start the timer. Only server messages can.

![An image with a list of items, (Flower, Wool, Terracotta, Mushroom Stem). Right next to the text there's the following grey text: "???"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2247d23552674bb7ec86fcbd65e0acbb6cd918b.png)
![An image with a list of items, (Flower, Wool, Terracotta, Mushroom Stem). Right next to the text there are times.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1fddda805cee0ffdd8d5e746860d71c9c744941.png)

Note: I (Sling) have contacted the owner of AngyBox (xdle) and have confirmed that the owner doesn't have any issues with this feature.

### Highlight broken item
While playing, items can break. Since I am not apart of the server's dev team, I don't have an explanation. But by doing certain actions, the `custom:{}` nbt tag can be added onto items.

These items will not work for trades unless fixed with the `/fixitem` command.

This mod introduces a highlight to any item with the `custom:{}` nbt tag in the hotbar, inventory, storage containers.

In the tooltip of a broken item, the mod lets you know in writing that its broken and to run `/fixitem`

![Image of a hotbar with minecraft items. The items in the third and ninth hotbar slot are highlighted with a red box.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bd24cdac9327d650b3d1d59cd69e6f1cb802230.png)
![The player's inventory with multiple items inside. A box highlighed item in red is being hovered, A new line in the minecraft tooltip is advising the user to run `/fixitem`](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/359f4835d3983330eadf82adeb62dec78f2360d0_0.webp)

### Highlight wool from `/daily` command.
The black wool you get from the `/daily` command won't work unless you fix it at its specific trader.

This mod highlights this unusable wool in yellow and advises the user to fix it at the Black Wool trader.

![The player's inventory with multiple items inside. A box highlighed item in yellow is being hovered, A new line in the minecraft tooltip is advising the user to trade this wool at the "BW Trader"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d1401b5b73f76d448ad1161fcab4e05e277501d.png)

### Hide server TIP's
Sometimes the server's tips can flood the chat and be annoying.

This mod can hide these tips.
![Side by side chats. On the left there is a chat with just a welcome message, on the right there is a chat with TIP messages and a welcome message.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25e847ebc0aa3a2d15758dbf7068949fcb4464e5.png)

### Desert loot summary.
When in the desert, the chat can easily get spammed.
![The chat getting spammed with `You found a X` messages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c9020c60047aa934df912b3818bb58572ccc7e3.png)

This mod hides these messages and shows a summary after a delay (Can be configured)
![A list of Desert loot, summarized into a single list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7463cd27800b69f61001e59ed755eb280d87471b.png)

# Configuration
We use [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) for our configuration.

## Things that can be configured
### Chat
- Summarize mining loot chat | Yes / No
  - Summarizes the Desert loot into a list
- Intercept GEM FIND messages | Yes / No
  - Hide GEM FIND messages and include it into the summary list
- Intercept PET DROP messages | Yes / No
  - Hide PET DROP messages and include it into the summary list
- Hide server TIP messages | Yes / No
  - Hide the TIP messages 
- Mining Loot summary seconds | Integer
  - The delay set for 
### Timer
- Enabled | Yes / No
  - Toggles the timer on and off
- HUD X | Integer
  - Sets the X position of the timer 
- HUD Y | Integer
  - Sets the Y position of the timer
- Alignment | Left / Center / Right
  - Sets the text position, When right is selected it flips how text is displayed
- Order | Submenu
  - Sets the order of the timer list.
### Inventory
- Highlight Broken Items | Yes / No
  - Toggles the Red highlight for broken items and the broken tooltip
- Highlight Unusable Wool | Yes / No
  - Toggles the Yellow highlight for unusable wool
